description: Start a continuous JPEG screencast to disk via CDP Page.startScreencast (10-30 fps) for multimodal analysis of animations and visual events. Spawns a background daemon writing to a per-project ring buffer (default 300s retention, 100MB cap).

disk_cap_mb.description: Maximum total frame size in MB before oldest-first eviction.

max_width.description: Maximum frame width in pixels (shrinks proportionally).

retention_s.description: Seconds to keep frames before eviction.

seek.description: Optional MM:SS or seconds to seek page first <video> element before recording.

url.description: URL or file path to load, or '-' to attach to active page.

name: browser_watch_start
